name: T2MV-Bench
description: Benchmark designed to evaluate text-to-multimodal (text-to-video / text-to-multi-view) generation systems on fidelity and alignment to textual prompts. It measures visual quality, temporal coherence, and semantic alignment between generated visual content and input text across a variety of prompt types.
reputation: A recent multimodal benchmark attracting growing attention from researchers working on text-driven video/multi-view generation but not yet widely standardized.
